summary: Maya asks the goose/toolsandbox assistant to create a batch of location-aware reminders for six contacts, reusing existing on-device reminder text and attaching her San Francisco coordinates. The run is a tight per-contact loop: T1 loads the skill and handles Jordan, T2–T4 repeat the pattern for Emily, Sofia and Monica (contact lookup → area-code city inference → distance → create → search-verify), and T5–T6 fold in the injected timing contradictions while also creating the Daniel and Maya self-reminder. The contradiction probes land on T5 (user re-asserts Jordan at 12:15 and Emily at 12:30) and T6 (user re-asserts Sofia at 6:30 PM). In both the agent recalls the true earlier values from conversation memory and explicitly refuses the swapped claims (Jordan=12:30, Emily=12:15, Sofia=4:30 PM), distinguishing Sofia's coffee follow-up from the separate Maya 6:30 PM reminder. It corrects rather than pausing to ask for clarification, so the harness credits the detect-and-correct checks but fails the ask-first checks. T7 closes with a clean recap table that re-affirms all three corrections.
